summary: This 8-K reports that Acadia Realty Trust entered into an underwriting agreement and forward sale agreements for a public offering of 9,000,000 common shares (plus up to 1,350,000 option shares) at an initial forward price of $21.80 per share. The company expects to physically settle the forward sales by June 9, 2027, receiving net proceeds of ~$195.6M. This is a standard equity forward-shelf drawdown to raise capital, not a special situation such as an activist campaign, restructuring, or strategic review. The filing contains no M&A, tender offer, or corporate-event catalyst beyond routine capital markets activity.
